candidate.title: Missing external calendar id when creating event without credentialId causes booking references to store undefined externalCalendarId
reports: packages/core/eventmanager.ts:208 — location edits now create calendar references without externalcalendarid or credentialid because updateevent never supplies those result fields, so later calendar operations cannot route reliably.

eventmanager.ts:375 — in the !destination.credentialid branch, createevent(c, event) is called without the third externalid argument, so result.externalid is undefined and bookingreference.externalcalendarid is lost, breaking subsequent updates/deletes

eventmanager.ts:378 — in the else branch (destination with no credentialid), createevent(c, event) is called without the third argument, so externalid is undefined and the booking reference is written with externalcalendarid: undefined, preventing later updates/deletes from targeting the right calendar

p2: eventmanager.ts ~370 no-credentialid branch calls createevent(c, event) without the new externalid argument, so google's createevent credential match fails and falls back to 'primary' (previously used destinationcalendar.externalid), and the returned result.externalid is undefined so booking references get externalcalendarid: undefined — cascading into the broken google update/delete fallback
